definitions.explanation: A ballot cast with nothing written on it, used to record turnout without choosing any candidate or option.

definitions.gloss: white ballot; vote in favor (in the Diet)
definitions.explanation: In Japan's Diet, a white voting slip indicating approval of a motion, as opposed to a blue slip for opposition.

examples.japanese: {白票|はくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
{白票|はくひょう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{投票|とうひょう}{率|りつ}→投票率：22200_touhyouritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Blank ballots are also counted in the voter turnout.

examples.japanese: ⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧がいなかった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{白票|はくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
examples.english: There was no candidate I could support, so I cast a blank ballot as a form of protest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白票|はくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じて→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}した→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The lawmaker cast a white ballot to vote in favor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{採決|さいけつ}→採決：08395_saiketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白票|はくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めた→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: In the vote, white ballots made up the majority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採決|さいけつ}→採決：08395_saiketsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧{白票|はくひょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧{青票|あおひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In House of Councillors votes, white ballots indicating approval and blue ballots indicating opposition are used.

notes:
Compound of {白|はく} (white) + ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (ballot, vote). The word has two distinct uses depending on context.

USAGE:
- In ordinary elections, a {白票|はくひょう} is a blank ballot — a deliberate abstention that still counts toward turnout.
- In the Diet's standing-vote procedure, a white slip means approval and a blue slip ({青票|あおひょう}) means opposition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白票|はくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧: to cast a blank (or white) ballot
- {白票|はくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: white ballots form a majority

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青票|あおひょう}: blue ballot — the opposing vote in Diet procedure
- ⟦{棄権|きけん}→棄権：16194_kiken⟧: abstention — declining to vote at all, not casting a blank ballot
